name: Telegram-style Messenger
summary: Mobile messenger modelled on Telegram's open-source client: chat list with folder tabs, pinned and muted chats, unread badges, chat screen with bubbles, replies, reactions, voice and photo messages, group chat, profile with shared media, and settings.
useWhen: Starting a mobile messenger or in-app chat product
Needing a reference for a chat list, a chat screen with replies and reactions, and a profile page
avoidWhen: An AI assistant chat, where the ai-chat components fit
A desktop inbox or support console: the layout is one phone-width column
source: Layout and behaviour modelled on Telegram's open-source mobile clients; rewritten compactly in React with neutral sample data and no Telegram assets
